name: Professor Pip

intro.text: That's the way to do it! The puppeteer's called the Professor, you know. Mr Punch first came to England in 1662. Samuel Pepys saw him in Covent Garden and wrote it in his diary.

win: Oh no it isn't! Oh yes it is. You won.
after: The sausages are the hardest part. Strings of them, every show. The crocodile does his best.
